runtime.privacy: No owner-like fields requested; only FID, LotId, OBJECTID_1, OBJECTID, Town_Lot_I, Extension_, SR_No, Diagram_No and geometry.
runtime.qualityScreenNote: A preliminary in-run Turf threshold checked ring area in longitude/latitude degrees and falsely treated the two sub-1m2 polygons as zero-area. That screen was superseded by this Shapely GEOS audit in EPSG:32735; both are valid, nonzero polygons. No geometry was modified.
runtime.identityClassification: Provisional source-row reference only; not official cadastral identity.

quality.method: Shapely 2.1.2 / GEOS on repo-proj4 EPSG:32735 output; no geometry repair. OGC validity via Shapely is_valid; exact intersections on all bbox-overlapping feature pairs.

fragmentContext.note: All three small rows belong to the repeated LotId 681 group. They were retained and audited without filtering or geometry repair.

quality.qualityHoldRationale: No invalid polygons, duplicate geometries, positive-area overlaps or overlay errors were found. Three of 76 rows (3.95%) are below 25 m2 and all cluster in the repeated LotId 681 group; that is a localized source-interpretation issue, not a widespread fragment pattern in this sample. No rows were filtered or repaired.
quality.analysisPurpose: Independent quality audit of every unique source row retained from the 13 planned cells. The geometry sample was projected with repository proj4; no repair or filtering was applied.

qualitySummary.note: Three small polygons are present and retained; all three share LotId 681. Their parcel interpretation remains a separate source identity question.
